This page is written with the tags of Sm2Shim, FlashMP3 and AudioButton, as on a wiki that moved to Gramophone without editing its pages. Each section shows the old wikitext, then what it renders. The old tags give the same players and buttons as <code>&lt;gramophone&gt;</code> and <code>&lt;playbutton&gt;</code>.

== flashmp3 ==
<pre>
<flashmp3>Ripple.mp3,Galactic Love.mp3|openplaylist=yes</flashmp3>
</pre>
<flashmp3>Ripple.mp3,Galactic Love.mp3|openplaylist=yes</flashmp3>

== Templates ==
Old templates that build the tags with <code><nowiki>{{#tag:...}}</nowiki></code> keep working:
<pre>
{{#tag:sm2|Testament of the Twin Stars.mp3}} {{#tag:flashmp3|Driven Star With You.mp3}}
</pre>
